param_input_item.param_description: variable names specified as a string array or cell array of character vectors.
a table or timetable whose variable names are used by the filter.
a nelson.io.parquet.ParquetInfo object whose variable names are used by the filter.

description.p: rowfilter creates a filter object that exposes variable names through dot notation.
Use relational operators >, >=, <, <=, ==, and ~= to create comparisons. Use logical operators &, |, and ~ to combine expressions.
The resulting object can be passed to parquetread or parquetDatastore with the RowFilter name-value pair. It can also be applied directly to a table with rf.apply(T).
